title: Yeasty Tender Greek Pork Souvlaki
description: A classic Greek dish featuring tender and flavorful pork skewers, perfect for a weeknight dinner. The yeast adds a unique flavor and tenderizes the meat.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine yeast, olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, oregano, salt, and black pepper.
Add the pork cubes to the bowl and toss to coat evenly with the marinade.
Let the pork marinate for at least 30 minutes, or up to 2 hours in the refrigerator.
Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
Thread the marinated pork cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Brush the grill or grill pan with olive oil to prevent sticking.
Grill the souvlaki for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, or until cooked through.
Serve the souvlaki hot, garnished with lemon wedges and parsley.
To serve, score the fat on the pork with a sharp knife to create a crispy texture.
